text:
Morgan: quick async check-in — kernel queue / batcher / prefetch snapshot

What I did: pushed the kernel rate-limiter tweak (avoid double-slot drain) and ran a microbench across the slot-packer logic. Observed lower tail latency overall but a KV eviction spike when prefetch was enabled for longer windows.

Blockers: canary in us-west-2 ran into OOM on job 8852 during sustained concurrency; looks like slot alignment + stale shard accounting. Need a quick config rollback or safer prefetch knobs.

Today: rollback prefetch window on canary, add more telemetry around slot-coalescer, and open a small PR to gate prefetch under backpressure.

Kai: can you paste the exact bench command and the model/seq len you used? also which runtime image tag?

Morgan: bench cmd: `./bench --model llama-13b-q4 --seq 1024 --concurrency 24 --runs 20 --rng-seed 42`
runtime image: `redwood/runtime:2026-03-15-kernel-opt`
results: avg latency 210ms -> 191ms (after change), p99 580ms -> 530ms. KV evict rate: 0.9% -> 3.2% when prefetch.window_ms=60.

Sasha: eviction pattern looks like flush loop hitting low-watermark then mass-evict. quick log snippet from canary: 
```
[2026-03-16T11:12:03Z] evict: shard=slot-42 threshold=512 used=510
[2026-03-16T11:12:03Z] prefetch: enqueued=600 free=8
[2026-03-16T11:12:04Z] slot-coalescer: align=4 pending=7
```

Jun: suggestion — reduce prefetch.window_ms to 10-20 for the canary and raise `cache_high_pct` to 86. Also set `slot_alignment=8` so allocator avoids the small-misaligned shards. I'll draft a 2-line config PR.

Morgan: applying those to canary now, pinging @Kai for hands-on deck with observability. If Jun can open the PR that'd be perfect. Thanks. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: scheduled `runtime-canary-smoke` job (id: 99821) to run at 2026-03-16T11:45:00Z. Logs will be available at https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/99821 once finished.

Kai: on it, I have lab access. If the canary fails we should fallback the route to `13b-vanilla` variant and disable prefetch globally for the affected pool.

Morgan: noted. I'll post the canary run output here when done (will include `top` + `dmesg` + bench CSV).
